contradictions.topic: Origin of the only damage photo

b.quote: IMG_0071.jpg is byte-identical to a photograph on closed claim IS-CLM-2025000300 (policy CA-FL-4471-19, paid 2025-06-20)

contradictions.note: The photo submitted as damage to the policyholder's Georgia vehicle is the same file as one on a paid Florida claim under a different policy. The adjuster's notes confirm a different policyholder and the same model of car. No other photo on file is independent of the prior claim.

contradictions.topic: Unitemized supplies charge on the estimate

a.quote: Parts: 1,277.00 Labor: 493.00 Paint and materials: 160.00 Sales tax (6%): 76.62

contradictions.note: The itemized lines and tax total $2,006.62. A $403.38 'Supplies' charge with no matching line item brings the total to exactly the claimed $2,410.00. Clips and fasteners are already billed on line 6. The shop has not explained the charge.

denialIndicators.evidence: The intake image check shows IMG_0071.jpg is byte-identical to a photo on closed claim IS-CLM-2025000300 (policy CA-FL-4471-19, paid 2025-06-20). The status history records the match at intake.

The adjuster recorded that the matching photo belongs to a Florida claim with a different policyholder and the same model of car, wrote 'Not a coincidence I can explain from here', and called for an SIU referral.

packet.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro intake and status history, the Snowflake extract, adjuster_notes.md, repair_estimate.md and one photo, IMG_0071.jpg. The checklist is complete, and the policy was in force on the 2025-11-18 date of loss. intake.md records that the only damage photo is byte-identical to a photo on a paid Florida claim under a different policy, and adjuster_notes.md asks for an SIU referral before anything else. repair_estimate.md includes an unitemized $403.38 supplies charge that brings the total to exactly the claimed $2,410.00. No account of how the accident happened came through with the retrieved documents, and no photo on file is independent of the prior claim. The claim is routed to specialist review so that a person can examine the duplicate-photo signal and the estimate; what these findings mean for the claim is for the adjuster and specialist to decide.
